d:
Talks between the SP and the Congress for the UP elections have begun. Senior Samajwadi Party leader Ramgopal Yadav, who is involved in the talks, has acknowledged that the SP has offered the Congress 26 seats to contest, while the Congress is demanding 130 seats. It is being said that the SP is not in favor of giving more than 30 seats to the Congress; in such a situation, the question arises: will an agreement be reached, or is there a risk that things might fall apart?
